title: Cabinet Refinishing in Alachua, FL | Kitchen Cabinets
description: Cabinet refinishing in Alachua, FL: degreased, sanded, primed, and finished in waterborne urethane enamel. A smart option before a full kitchen remodel.
heroIntro: A new look for sound kitchen and bath cabinets in Alachua homes, using a hard waterborne urethane enamel instead of new boxes.

questions: Is refinishing cheaper than replacing cabinets?
Can oak cabinets be painted without the grain showing?
How durable is painted cabinetry in a Florida kitchen?

body: Many kitchens in Alachua have solid cabinet boxes and only dated finishes. Orange oak from an earlier build, or a builder-grade stain that has worn through around the handles. If the boxes are square and the doors aren't warped, cabinet refinishing in Alachua, FL gets you a new look without tearing out countertops or plumbing. Our article on refinishing vs. replacing cabinets explains how to tell which you need.

We check that during the walkthrough. Water-damaged sink bases, swollen particleboard, and doors that no longer close flat are flagged in writing. That way you know before approving whether refinishing makes sense.
Cabinet paint fails when prep is rushed, so the steps are spelled out in your estimate:
bullets: Remove doors and drawer fronts and label each one so it goes back in the same spot
Degrease every surface, since years of cooking oil will keep any primer from bonding
Scuff-sand to dull the old finish, then vacuum and tack off the dust
Apply a bonding primer suited to the substrate, whether oak, maple, or another finish
Fill grain or dents where you want a smoother look

body: We finish cabinets with a waterborne urethane enamel. It cures hard enough for kitchen use and doesn't yellow the way older oil-based enamels did. Two full coats are standard. Boxes are protected and masked so countertops, backsplashes, and appliances stay clean. We can match a color from a single door or chip and paint a drawdown before committing. If you want coordinated wall colors for the rest of the kitchen, pair the job with interior painting in Alachua.
Oak needs extra attention because its open grain can show through the paint. Our guide to painting oak cabinets explains the grain-filling options and when it's worth the extra step.

The kitchen stays usable for much of the project, though you'll want to clear the counters. Your written estimate includes the schedule, so you'll know which days doors are off and when everything goes back up. You can stay home throughout. See our cabinet painting and refinishing page for the full method, or the Alachua city page for other services in town.

faqs.q: Will the oak grain show through painted cabinets?
faqs.a: Somewhat, unless the grain is filled first. We can fill it for a smoother finish or leave some texture if you like it, and the estimate will say which approach is included.

faqs.q: How durable is a painted cabinet finish?
faqs.a: A properly bonded waterborne urethane enamel cures hard and stands up to cleaning. Most early failures come from grease left under the primer, which is why degreasing is the first step.

faqs.q: Can I change the hardware at the same time?
faqs.a: Yes. If you're switching to new pulls with a different hole spacing, tell us during the walkthrough so old holes can be filled and new ones planned before the finish coats go on.

faqs.q: Can you refinish bathroom vanities too?
faqs.a: Yes. Vanities, built-ins, and laundry cabinets follow the same prep and coating system and can be added to the same estimate.
